name: BTC Watcher
author: MaxMad75
description: Bitcoin in the bar with what the tickers leave out: fees priced in your own currency so you can see what sending costs right now, the mempool backlog in blocks, difficulty and halving — and a notification when the price moves past a threshold you set.

barWidget.description: Bitcoin price, chain state and move alerts

schema.label: Currency
schema.description: Any of CoinGecko's 63 quote currencies, e.g. EUR, USD, JPY, SEK.

schema.label: Bar shows
schema.description: Comma-separated any of: price, change, block. Set from the panel's Settings fold.

schema.label: Change window (bar)
schema.description: Which look-back the percentage in the bar refers to.

schema.label: Poll interval (s)
schema.description: How often to refresh. Independent of the notification window; the history is what makes the windows work.

schema.label: Notification window
schema.description: Capped at an hour on purpose: a slower alert is a news article, not a notification.

schema.label: Quiet period (min)
schema.description: How long one direction stays silent after it fired.
